name: mitmproxy-mcp
description: перехват HTTP(S): правка и реплей трафика, реверс API, экспорт OpenAPI-наброска
argv: STATE="$HOME/.local/state/mitmproxy-mcp"; mkdir -p "$STATE" || exit 1; cd "$STATE" || exit 1; if command -v mitmproxy-mcp >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec mitmproxy-mcp; fi; test -x "$HOME/.venvs/mitmproxy-mcp/bin/mitmproxy-mcp" || { printf 'mitmproxy-mcp не собран: запусти mcp-station/bin/debug-setup.sh\n' >&2; exit 1; }; exec "$HOME/.venvs/mitmproxy-mcp/bin/mitmproxy-mcp"
